notes.title: We're Almost There!
notes.content:
We are excited to say that the new update is in the testing phase! Hyperspace : Andy's Adventure is growing and it will grow always! Thanks to all supporters!

Major Add-ons : 

Upgrade System 
           - 12 new upgrade for the spaceship features will directly affects gameplay
           - 6 new Boosters for the earning greater scores
Gameplay 
           - All environment visuals are polished!
           - Animations added!
           - Sound design & visuals has much more immersive feel!
           - Disco game mode!
UI
           - All menus are changed with the much cooler version!

Lot of bugs fixed!


Please take your seats before it's too late!

notes.title: Great Update is Coming!
notes.content: Huge update is on the way! New, dynamic UI's, Spacecraft Upgrade System and new look of the chapters is coming! Stay in touch!
